test_cases.title: Reject amount below minimum
test_cases.preconditions: Checkout is ready for card payment.
steps: Attempt to continue to payment authorization.
test_cases.expected: The amount is not eligible for submission because it is below the stated minimum of USD 1.00.

test_cases.title: Accept minimum eligible amount
test_cases.preconditions: Checkout is ready for card payment.
steps: Check whether the payment can be submitted.
test_cases.expected: The amount is eligible for submission at the inclusive lower limit.

test_cases.title: Accept amount one cent above minimum
test_cases.preconditions: Checkout is ready for card payment.
steps: Check whether the payment can be submitted.
test_cases.expected: The amount is eligible for submission within the stated range and cent increment.

test_cases.title: Accept amount one cent below maximum
test_cases.preconditions: Checkout is ready for card payment.
steps: Check whether the payment can be submitted.
test_cases.expected: The amount is eligible for submission within the stated range and cent increment.

test_cases.title: Accept maximum eligible amount
test_cases.preconditions: Checkout is ready for card payment.
steps: Check whether the payment can be submitted.
test_cases.expected: The amount is eligible for submission at the inclusive upper limit.

test_cases.title: Reject amount above maximum
test_cases.preconditions: Checkout is ready for card payment.
steps: Attempt to continue to payment authorization.
test_cases.expected: The amount is not eligible for submission because it is above the stated maximum of USD 10,000.00.

test_cases.title: Show order confirmation after approved authorization
test_cases.preconditions: The payment environment provides a documented test instrument that produces an approved authorization.
steps: Submit an eligible USD amount using the approved test instrument.
test_cases.expected: An order-confirmation page is displayed with an order reference and the final amount.

test_cases.title: Do not create an order after declined authorization
test_cases.preconditions: The payment environment provides a documented test instrument that produces a declined authorization.
steps: Submit an eligible USD amount using the declined-authorization test instrument.
test_cases.expected: No order is created and a payment-declined message is displayed.

test_cases.title: Mask payment details and omit them from confirmation
test_cases.preconditions: The payment environment provides a documented approved test instrument.
steps: Enter the test card number and security code.
Complete the approved test authorization and inspect the confirmation page.
test_cases.expected: The card number and security code are masked after entry, and neither is displayed on the confirmation page.

priority_rationales.rationale: High: accepting a below-minimum amount violates the specified eligibility range; likelihood is unassessed.
High: rejecting the inclusive minimum blocks a valid payment; likelihood is unassessed.
Medium: checks cent-step behavior immediately inside the lower boundary; likelihood is unassessed.
Medium: checks cent-step behavior immediately inside the upper boundary; likelihood is unassessed.
High: rejecting the inclusive maximum blocks a valid payment; likelihood is unassessed.
High: accepting an above-maximum amount violates the specified eligibility range; likelihood is unassessed.
Critical: an approved payment must produce order confirmation and the correct reference/amount; likelihood is unassessed.
Critical: creating an order for a declined payment has direct financial and order-integrity impact; likelihood is unassessed.
Critical: exposing card data conflicts with an explicit protection criterion; likelihood is unassessed.

open_questions: Which sandbox-provided test instruments produce approved and declined authorizations?
Does the stated eligibility range mean every amount outside it must be rejected before authorization?
How should amounts with more than two decimal places be handled?
Which card brands, expiry formats, and security-code lengths are supported?
Is the amount entered by the customer or calculated from the cart?

coverage_notes.criterion: AC1: The accepted currency is USD.
gaps: No explicit non-USD rejection case is asserted because the criterion states the accepted currency but does not explicitly define rejection behavior for other currencies; confirm expected handling.

coverage_notes.criterion: AC2: An amount from USD 1.00 through USD 10,000.00 inclusive, in USD 0.01 increments, is eligible for submission.
gaps: Confirm explicit rejection behavior outside the eligible interval and for precision beyond cents.

coverage_notes.criterion: AC3: Successful authorization displays order confirmation with order reference and final amount.
gaps: The environment's approved test instrument is unspecified.

coverage_notes.criterion: AC4: Declined authorization creates no order and displays a payment-declined message.
gaps: The environment's decline test instrument is unspecified.

coverage_notes.criterion: AC5: Card number and security code are masked after entry and not displayed on confirmation.
